name: UUGRN FIXME: Unix hands-on evening
description: hands-on Unix/Linux evening with short talks, pizza and tinkering
note: German; every 1st Friday (6 Nov cancelled), next 8 Jan
details:
FIXME is the hands-on evening of the Unix User Group Rhein-Neckar e.V. for the Linux and Unix community in the region: members bring a topic or a short informal talk ("let me show you something"), and everyone can try things out directly instead of only talking about them. Talks are not recorded.

Free and without registration; drinks paid on site, usually a shared pizza order. The 6 Nov 2026 evening is cancelled; the January edition moves to 8 Jan 2027 because of New Year.
